field.comment: Canonical unpadded base64url credential ID; unique together with rpId, enforce with an application-managed database composite unique constraint.
field.name: credentialId

field.comment: Canonical owner, never an alias account.
field.name: ownerId

field.comment: Random opaque base64url handle, never an alias or user ID.
field.name: userHandle

field.comment: Unpadded base64url X.509 SubjectPublicKeyInfo for validated ES256 P-256 or RS256 RSA key; stored format is SPKI.
field.name: publicKeySpki

field.comment: COSE algorithm -7 (ES256) or -257 (RS256), from verified registration key.
field.name: algorithm
